free_tier_limits: 300 credits per month; this is a hard limit. When exhausted, all projects pause until the next billing cycle unless the account upgrades. Auto recharge is unavailable on Free.
rate_limits: Up to 500 requests per minute for most requests. Some operations have stricter limits; API deploys are limited to 3 per minute and 100 per day.
resolution_notes: auth_type: oauth2; Netlify explicitly says it uses OAuth2 and PATs are bearer tokens: https://docs.netlify.com/api-and-cli-guides/api-guides/get-started-with-api/#authentication. free_tier_limits: 300 credits/month with a hard limit and project pausing: https://docs.netlify.com/manage/accounts-and-billing/billing/billing-for-credit-based-plans/how-credits-work/. rate_limits: 500/minute generally; API deploys 3/minute and 100/day: https://docs.netlify.com/api-and-cli-guides/api-guides/get-started-with-api/#rate-limiting.
